verdict.rationale: xAI hosts an official MCP server that agents can connect to, but it only gives access to the xAI documentation, not to the model, inference, or management capabilities [grok-docs-24]. The Remote MCP Tools page [grok-docs-12], which the probe [grok-probe-4] points to, describes Grok acting as an MCP client, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: an MCP server exposing API functionality (inference, files/collections, management), setup and auth docs for connecting agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
